(1st award) | previous = [[2019 Ballon d'Or|2019]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2022 Ballon d'Or|2022]] }} The '''2021 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2021 Golden Ball'''}}), was the 65th annual ceremony of the [[Ballon d'Or]], presented by ''[[France Football]]'', recognising the best footballers in the world in 2021. The nominees for the ceremony were announced on 8 October 2021. Right before the ceremony, France Football announced that along with the Men's and Women's Ballon d'Or, [[Kopa Trophy]] and [[Yashin Trophy]], two new awards would be given: the Best Club and Best Striker of the Year. [[Lionel Messi]] won the award for a record-extending seventh time after captaining Argentina to the [[2021 Copa América|2021 Copa America]], its first senior international title since 1993.{{Cite web |date=14 July 2021 |title=Top scorer, best goalkeeper, player of the tournament and Fair Play award at the CONMEBOL Copa America 2021 |url=https://copaamerica.com/en/news/the-best-of-the-conmebol-copa-america-2021/ Lewandowski]] finished second following his record-setting 41-goal season in the [[2020–21 Bundesliga]] campaign, and [[Jorginho (footballer, born December 1991)|Jorginho]] finished third after
